source: Caveats NOT solvable by this method, irreducible because the classes are rare per se (recorded here, not just asserted in a docstring)
zero_held_out_is_a_hard_floor: If a class/superclass is never held out at all across the pooled validation splits, shrinkage collapses that estimate entirely to the prior/hyperprior mean. That's the honest thing to report — a wide-credible-interval population-level guess instead of NaN or a spurious in-sample number — but it is not new information recovered from nowhere.
physical_sample_size_is_untouched: E.g. 'nov' (novae) has 8 sources in the whole 4FGL-DR4 catalog before any split. Whatever the estimation method, the ceiling on how precisely its true recall can ever be known is set by how many such sources exist in the catalog, not by CV design or Bayesian modeling choices downstream of that fact.
oracle_branch_training_is_untouched: Branches still train only on rows whose TRUE superclass matches ('Known Limitation: Oracle Branch Training') — this shrinkage improves how a branch's own small-sample performance is REPORTED; it does nothing about the router's/gate's misrouting rate at deployment.
prior_choice_is_a_real_disclosed_subject: How much a rare class shrinks toward its immediate superclass mean vs. a shared cross-superclass mean depends on hyperprior/concentration choices that are themselves not fully identifiable from ~7 superclass groups. This is a stated modeling choice, not something a full sensitivity sweep across 2-3 reasonable prior specifications was run to confirm in this reporting-only pass — treat the reported credible intervals accordingly.
it_changes_what_is_reported_not_what_is_: A shrunk estimate is a better-calibrated GUESS about a rare class's true recall under a stated statistical model — it is still a guess. The underlying epistemic problem (very little test evidence exists for classes like 'nov'/'gc'/'sey') persists at whatever confidence level this report states honestly.
reporting_only_scope: These shrunk estimates augment/replace the raw per-class numbers shown in REPORTS ONLY. They are not read by QUALITY_METRICS, SELECTION_METRIC, or any Borda ranking in this file (Stage 1/3/4/8 are untouched). Using them as an actual selection criterion would be a larger methodological change needing its own validation (e.g. checking whether it changes which architecture chain-CV picks) before being trusted for that role.
